Q01.sql:
WITH closure_calls AS (
  SELECT
    fc.site_id,
    COUNT(*) AS closure_calls
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` AS fc
  WHERE fc.is_account_closure_call
    AND fc.agent_user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fc.site_id
),
cc_cost AS (
  SELECT
    cc_id AS site_id,
    SUM(expense) AS total_expense_2025
  FROM `fennmoor-analytics.sbx_finance.cc_cost_per_call_fy25`
  WHERE fiscal_period LIKE '2025%'
  GROUP BY cc_id
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  s.city,
  s.state,
  s.operator,
  cc.closure_calls,
  cost.total_expense_2025
FROM closure_calls AS cc
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
  ON cc.site_id = s.site_id
LEFT JOIN cc_cost AS cost
  ON s.site_id = cost.site_id
ORDER BY cc.closure_calls DESC

Q09.why: no column holds delinquency_rate (2 of 3 match)
Q09.sql:
WITH OPEN_LOANS AS (
  SELECT
    PRODUCT_CODE,
    BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS N
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE ACCOUNT_FAMILY = 'LOAN'
    AND IS_OPEN
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
DLQ AS (
  SELECT
    A.PRODUCT_CODE,
    A.BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS D
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily` DD
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account` A USING (ACCOUNT_KEY)
  WHERE DD.DPD >= 30
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  O.PRODUCT_CODE,
  B.BRANCH_NAME,
  O.N AS OPEN_LOANS,
  COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0) AS DELINQUENT_LOANS,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(DLQ.D, O.N) AS DELINQUENCY_RATE
FROM OPEN_LOANS O
LEFT JOIN DLQ USING (PRODUCT_CODE, BRANCH_ID)
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_branch` B ON B.BRANCH_ID = O.BRANCH_ID
ORDER BY DELINQUENCY_RATE DESC
